title_summary.title: Discrete CIP and VRP with Governance

source.text: P1 Discrete Liquidity Pools: CIP and VRP with waterfall priority and governance staking sink. Implement discrete CIP (Creator Incentive Pool) and VRP (Validator Reward Pool) as separate ledger accounts with waterfall-priority funding from Treasury. Add governance staking as a Z1U sink mechanism. Tokenomics persona obligations: supply/emissions impact on CIP/VRP funding rates, incentive source traceability (which pool funds which agent class), liquidity/treasury/governance authority (who controls pool parameters), financial advisory boundary (staking APY claims require qualified review). Stories: US-Z1-M3-05, US-Z1-M3-06.
